m201-size.observed_description: A sunny village street: a big three-floor stone house on the left with a big golden dog standing in front of it, and a tiny white thatched cottage on the right with a small white puppy sitting in front. No people, no cars.
m201-size.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The small dog is small by design; its target box meets the minimum hit area.
